# Immo-Boussole Orchestrator

> CLI & web orchestrator to deploy, manage, monitor, and update multiple Immo-Boussole instances on local or remote Docker hosts.

## Key Files

- `app/main.py` — FastAPI application entry point
- `app/config.py` — All configuration via pydantic-settings
- `app/registry.py` — YAML-backed instance registry (CRUD)
- `app/docker_manager.py` — Docker SDK abstraction (local/SSH/TCP)
- `app/notifier.py` — Webhook + SMTP notifications
- `app/scheduler.py` — APScheduler health poller
- `app/mcp_server.py` — MCP server for Claude Desktop
- `app/auth.py` — HTTP Basic auth
- `app/models.py` — Pydantic request/response models
- `app/routers/instances.py` — REST API (CRUD + lifecycle)
- `app/routers/logs.py` — SSE log streaming
- `cli/main.py` — Typer CLI
- `templates/` — Jinja2 HTML templates
- `static/css/main.css` — Vanilla CSS design system (dark/light)
- `static/js/app.js` — Frontend JS (theme, SSE, API calls)

## Architecture

- Python 3.12 + FastAPI + Uvicorn
- `python-on-whales` for Docker SDK
- Typer + Rich for CLI
- APScheduler for background health polling
- MCP library for Claude Desktop integration
- YAML file for instance registry persistence
- Jinja2 for server-side HTML rendering
- Vanilla CSS with dark/light theme tokens

## API Endpoints

- `GET /api/instances` — list all
- `POST /api/instances` — create
- `GET /api/instances/{name}` — detail
- `PUT /api/instances/{name}` — update config
- `DELETE /api/instances/{name}` — remove
- `POST /api/instances/{name}/start|stop|restart|update|clone|backup|restore`
- `GET /api/instances/{name}/logs` — last N lines
- `GET /api/instances/{name}/logs/stream` — SSE stream
- `GET /health` — liveness probe
